response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_rate FROM g WHERE bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg_rate DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average rate across all albums is the unweighted mean of the per-group rates. The NULL-AlbumId group counts as one group, as the request says. Groups with no non-null Bytes have a NULL rate and are ignored.
Each group's rate is SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds), computed as a real number with no rounding. SUM skips NULL Bytes.
